feeds.title: Montague Bikes Blog
feeds.description: Explore stories, tutorials, and advice from the Montague Bikes team. Since 1987, Montague Bikes has been dedicated to crafting high-performance, full-size folding bikes. As the world's leading maker of such bikes, Montague prioritizes performance and ride quality, offering some of the most versatile bikes available.

feeds.title: Folding Bike Guy » Folding Bikes
feeds.description: My name is Mark, and I'm an Engineer and cycling enthusiast hailing from Australia. My mission is helping you choose the best folding bikes and folding electric bikes by providing detailed reviews and guides.

feeds.title: Dizzy's folding bike
feeds.description: I'm Désirée. I was re-introduced to cycling after a break of more than fifty years! John rekindled a love of cycling that had been neglected for nearly two decades. Our purchase of folding bikes opened up a whole new world for us. It has taken us on many interesting rides, exploring our immediate environment, as well as trips further afield. This blog chronicles our cycling adventures.

feeds.title: Bike Folded » News
feeds.description: You might have to spend a lot of time researching and deciding which is the best folding bicycle for your needs. We love folding bicycles and have tested hundreds of them, so we know this is not an easy decision, especially for inexperienced shoppers. Here you can find the best folding bikes and our detailed reviews.

feeds.title: VELLO Bike Blog
feeds.description: Find all the latest VELLO Bike news and events here - our blog keeps you updated with the latest trends and developments in the field of folding bikes and urban mobility in general. VELLO bikes are compact folding bicycles developed for urban mobility.

feeds.title: Folding Bike Hut
feeds.description: If you're interested in buying a folding bike, you've come to the right place! The Folding Bike Hut is here to provide you with the best folding bike reviews so that you can get the right information that you need when it comes to buying a foldable bike.
